title: Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors

quotes.text: November 8, 2026
quotes.for: The date of the NVIDIA Board of Directors statement on the independent investigation.

quotes.text: The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.
quotes.for: The board's initiation of an independent investigation following reports on foreign intelligence targeting.

quotes.text: A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation.
quotes.for: Oversight of the investigation by independent directors and outside counsel.

quotes.text: While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information.
quotes.for: The board's statement that it had no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

quotes.text: Jensen fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it.
quotes.for: Huang's support for and commitment to cooperate with the board's review.

quotes.text: The Board has confidence in Jensen and his leadership team and will provide further updates as appropriate.
quotes.for: The board's confidence in Huang on November 8, 2026, and its promise of updates.

quotes.text: I owe my family and all of you an apology. I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.
quotes.for: Jensen Huang's apology to his family and employees admitting infidelity.

quotes.text: I take full responsibility for what I did and the hurt I caused, and I accept the criticism that comes with it.
quotes.for: Huang taking responsibility in his message to employees.
